_meta.title: Gaiada permission catalog (IAM-01b)
_meta.status: PROTOTYPED — derived from source 2026-08-10; frozen only after owner review (IAM-07a)
_meta.keyFormat: <domain>.<resource>.<action> — domain is the owning module, or `core` for non-module kinds; the mapping to the real Cerbos kind is carried by cerbosKind/cerbosAction (e.g. search.property.update -> resource_search_property).

classes.grantable: role-assignable enforcement primitive; maps 1:1 to a Cerbos (kind, action) pair
classes.relationship: held by owning the resource (or via the hub channel for mcp_tool.call), NEVER by any role; bypass-exempt: no wildcard, no superadmin, and no future `owner` role may reach these (Ruling 3)

_meta.sensitive: assessed 2026-08-10 for step-up auth + D-10 approval routing; touches HR/people data, finance, client commitments, deploys/provisioning, credentials/identity, or cross-company access. Owner review pending — tighten additively, loosen only by owner decision.
_meta.countsNote: DERIVED from `permissions` below — re-derive rather than hand-edit. HIER-5 (2026-08-11) found this block stale after HIER-3 retired the `team` kind: it still read 61/230/215 while the array held 60/226/211. Nothing enforced it, so it drifted silently — the same hand-maintained-number rot this program has hit repeatedly. `role-permission-bundles.db.test.ts` pins the BUNDLE artifact's own counts; this block had no equivalent guard.
